name: Yuuri
source: A princess from another world, Magunashia. She was captured by the evil organization Greed, and they have been torturing and humiliating her for a while, even to the point of raping her. She wishes that one day, her big brother will come and save her.
translation: A princess from another world, Magunashia. She was captured by the evil organization Greed, and they have been torturing and humiliating her for a while, even to the point of raping her. She wishes that one day, her big brother will come and save her.
